user.title: Add Gira shutter controller
user.description: Enter the Bluetooth MAC address of your Gira "Jal+Schaltuhr" and choose a name. The device must be in pairing mode and within range of your Bluetooth adapter or proxy. It is connected and paired once to check that it can be reached.

data_description.address: The MAC address as shown in the Home Assistant Bluetooth monitor, e.g. AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
data_description.name: The name of the device in Home Assistant.

name.title: Set up Gira shutter controller
name.description: A Gira shutter controller was discovered. Put it into pairing mode, choose a name and submit. The device is connected and paired once to check that it can be reached.

data_description.name: The name of the device in Home Assistant.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the device. Make sure it is in pairing mode and within range of your Bluetooth adapter or proxy.
error.device_not_found: The device is not seen by any Bluetooth adapter or proxy. Check the address, the power supply and the range.
error.invalid_address: This is not a valid MAC address. Use the format AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.

abort.already_in_progress: A setup for this device is already in progress.
